title: First hour
summary: Six tiny C tasks. Fill in the placeholder, press Run, and keep going.

lessons.title: Hello
lessons.goal: Print Hello, world on its own line. Replace the placeholder in printf, then press RUN.

lessons.title: Variables
lessons.goal: A variable holds a number. Replace the placeholder with any integer so the program prints that number.

lessons.title: If
lessons.goal: C can choose. If score is 60 or more, print pass. Otherwise print fail. Fill in the condition, then RUN.

lessons.title: Loop
lessons.goal: Loops repeat work. Print 1 through 5, one number per line. Fill in the loop bound, then RUN.

lessons.title: Array
lessons.goal: An array is a list of numbers. Add them up so the program prints 20. Replace the placeholder in the loop.

lessons.title: Function
lessons.goal: A function names a calculation. Make twice return n times 2. Replace the placeholder, then RUN.
